props.gloss_en: Rava: where he became aware first of the reaping and grinding done unwitting of Shabbat, then of those done unwitting of the labours -- reaping draws reaping and grinding draws grinding
Rava: but where he became aware first of the reaping done intentional of Shabbat and unwitting of the labours -- reaping draws reaping and the grinding with it

Abaye: grinding too draws grinding [the opposite grinding is atoned as well]
Abaye's reason: the name 'grinding' is one

Rava: if he brought it for the third, the third and second are atoned, the first is not
Rava: if he brought it for the middle one, all are atoned
Abaye: even if he brought an offering for any one of them, all are atoned
the stam, of Rava: he holds drawing, he does not hold drawing by what was itself drawn

half a grogeret reaped and ground unwitting of Shabbat, and half a grogeret intentional of Shabbat and unwitting of the labours, do not combine
the mishna: one who ate forbidden fat and forbidden fat in one lapse of awareness is liable only one [sin-offering]

the mishna: the stringency of one kind over many -- half an olive-bulk and again half an olive-bulk of one kind: liable
the mishna: [two halves] of two kinds -- exempt
R' Yehoshua: dishes separate [prohibited food eaten from two dishes counts separately]
